ITEM 1 | Glossy orange-red cylindrical pieces, roughly 4-6 cm long and 1.5-2 cm thick, some sliced into rounds and halves, smooth surface with slight caramelized sheen and darker edges, firm texture, sitting on the left side of the plate | 120
ITEM 2 | Pale yellow-green crinkled leafy strands, wilted and limp, with cream-colored moist sheen, spread across the right half of the plate in a loose mound about 10 cm across | 130
ITEM 3 | Light tan crumbly grainy mass with small irregular pieces, slightly moist, partly mixed among the leafy strands in the center of the plate | 45
ITEM 4 | Single small dark green leaf piece, flat and glossy, partly under the carrot pieces near the top center | 8
ITEM 5 | Brown-orange sausage-shaped pieces, about 5-7 cm long and 2 cm thick, with browned, slightly glossy surfaces and a few darker charred spots, clustered at the lower left of the plate | 75
